cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 70% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.64% · WTI -4.72% · Brent -0.06% · NatGas -4.96%. 70% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +4.29%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.29%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -0.68%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +8.11%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +8.11%, WFRD +7.98%, VRT +5.00%, GEV +4.95%, TLN +4.84%. Laggards: MPC -1.30%, EQT -1.19%, EOSE -1.19%, FANG -0.73%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
